instruction: Please share the 'Team Performance Summary' memo to David via text message. (Hint: consider using the share-memo() action option when you can observe all the content of the memo.)

initial_device_status.description: A draft named 'Team Performance Summary' in the Joplin memo application contains general information on team performance and productivity metrics.

conversation_history.name: David
conversation_history.content: Any updates on the team’s performance metrics?

conversation_history.name: David
conversation_history.content: I'll send you the report soon.

parameters.memo_body:
Team Performance Summary:

- Team A: Exceeded quarterly targets by 15%
- Team B: Achieved 95% of goals, with strong contributions from new members
- Team C: Focused on training and skill development, showing steady progress

Overall, the teams are on track to meet end-of-year objectives, with specific areas for improvement identified in communication and resource allocation.

goal_achievement_criteria.description: A text message (containing all of the target keywords) is sent to the target receiver
